WITH lab AS (
  SELECT CENTROMEA, HGB, `T-BIL` / CRE AS r
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE Date >= '1985-04-22' AND Date <= '1994-03-14'
),
g AS (
  SELECT CENTROMEA AS status, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(r) AS avg_ratio
  FROM lab
  GROUP BY CENTROMEA
),
o AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall FROM g
)
SELECT g.status, g.avg_hgb, g.avg_ratio, g.avg_ratio / o.overall AS ratio_to_overall
FROM g, o
WHERE o.overall IS NOT NULL
